Tree state: CLEAN at 86a04a6 ("bump qwen embedding max_in_flight 1000 -> 2000"), branch master, no uncommitted changes. Workspace = 4 crates: symbiotic-core (148 LoC shared vocabulary: ModelIdentity/QueueId/ModelTier/Sensitivity), symbiotic-model (2837 LoC: provider traits + ModelQueueConfig + default_model_queue_config catalog at crates/symbiotic-model/src/lib.rs:326-441 + QueuedChat/QueuedEmbedding wrappers + rate buckets), symbiotic-queue (1599 LoC durable SQLite queue), symbiotic-trace (525 LoC ModelInvocationTrace + jsonl sinks). KEY CORRECTION for the parent plan: throttle_wait_ms / queue_wait_ms / run_ms are NOT recorded anywhere in foundation — they live in symbiotic-memory/src/queue.rs::QueueEvent (lines 92-96, with request_units/input_units), recorded by symbiotic-memory/src/providers/queue.rs:265-281, written to provider-queue/model-queue-traces.jsonl. Foundation's own recorded timing is symbiotic-trace::TimingTrace { queued_ms, provider_ms, total_ms } on ModelInvocationTrace (set in symbiotic-model run_queued, lib.rs:782-785). So the foundation deliverable is (a) the ModelCapabilities catalog+trait seam in symbiotic-model, and (b) the generic LatencySummary/percentile vocabulary + ModelInvocationTrace summarizer in symbiotic-trace; the throttle-wait p50/p95 accessor itself is a thin companion in symbiotic-memory reusing that vocabulary (symbiotic-memory already deps symbiotic-trace, Cargo.toml:34). Attach point for capabilities: do NOT add a field to ProviderDescriptor — it is constructed by plain struct literals at ~10 non-test sites across 3 repos (foundation lib.rs:1490,1555,1612,1771 + tests; symbiotic-memory providers/foundation.rs:87,257) and a new field is a compile break everywhere; instead mirror the proven default_model_queue_config pattern (pure additive fn, unknown → None) plus a default-implemented method on trait ModelProvider (lib.rs:183) so every existing impl inherits it. Consumers verified: symbiotic-memory (git dep on foundation, imports Chat/Embedding traits, ModelQueueConfig, default_model_queue_config, SqliteQueue, TraceSink), symbiotic-mem-bench (ship line; git deps on symbiotic-core+symbiotic-queue only, but .cargo/config.toml [patch] redirects ALL four foundation crates + symbiotic-memory to local paths, so local foundation edits are live there; does NOT currently dep symbiotic-model or symbiotic-trace directly), smartoffice/crates/execution (PATH deps on core/model/queue; imports ChatMessage, ChatProvider, ChatRequest, ModelQueueConfig, OpenAiCompatibleChatProvider, QueuedChatProvider, SqliteQueue, Sensitivity). mem-bench today re-derives queue waits from event timestamps (src/lib.rs:351 summarize_queue_timing over BenchQueueEvent src/lib.rs:170, which doesn't even deserialize throttle_wait_ms) — the new accessors make that raw parsing obsolete without changing what is recorded.
